name: Fire Aura
description: At the start of each of the creature's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the creature or hits it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

At the start of each of the creature's turns, each creature within 5 feet of it takes 3 (1d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the creature or hits it with a melee attack takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.
At the end of each of the creature's turns, each creature of the creature's choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the creature takes 3 (1d6) Fire damage.

At the start of each of the creature’s turns, each creature within 10 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage, and flammable objects in that aura that aren’t being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the creature or hits it with a melee attack while within 5 feet of it takes 7 (2d6) fire damage.
